summary.headline: Kwality guides FY27 sales above INR700 crores at 26-27% EBITDA margin; oncology share fell to 20% and gross margin is 53% in Q1.
summary.overview: Management reiterated FY27 sales of over INR700 crores with 26-27% EBITDA margin, while acknowledging oncology's mix was about 20% of revenue against an earlier 26%. Q1 oncology revenue was INR30-35 crores, and gross margin was stated as 53%, down from 56-57% in the prior quarter. Growth is attributed to registrations in MENA, GCC and LATAM markets, with 60-70 registrations stated over the last three quarters. Management outlined a long-dated pipeline (biosimilars, hormone plant, 40 oral solid BE programmes) but most of it is excluded from current guidance and depends on timelines that are not yet secured. Governance questions on auditor change (KPMG, Q3/Q4 FY27) and debtor days (208 days, guided to 165-170) also came up.

financial_highlights.change: Down from 56-57% in previous quarter, per management
Down from 26% as stated in Q&A
Management expects ~155-160 days in regular operations

financial_highlights.value: INR195 crores; management breakup totals INR185-190 crores
financial_highlights.change: Hormone INR70 cr, oncology INR50 cr, BE INR25-30 cr, working capital INR20 cr, biosimilar R&D INR10-15 cr

segments.name: Oncology
segments.commentary: Q1 revenue of INR30-35 crores; mix about 20%. FY27 oncology target about INR100-110 crores, with expansion adding 45-50% capacity after completion by March 2027 and registrations expected by Q4 FY27.

segments.name: General facility
segments.commentary: 75-80% utilised; expansion of machinery and area expected to add at least 20% capacity. Expected to be the largest contributor in FY30 at about 40% of sales.

segments.name: Biologicals (Unit 5)
segments.commentary: Erythropoietin pre-clinical complete; clinical trials to start Nov/Dec 2026; Indian sales targeted FY28 at INR80-100 crores. 500 L bioreactor installed but CDSCO approval only for 100 L.

segments.name: Hormone (Unit 6)
segments.commentary: Commissioning by November 2026; INR70-80 crores ROW/tender sales in FY28 and about INR200 crores by FY29 if COPP and BE are completed. Management said FY30 is when this is in its guidance.

guidance_outlook: FY27 sales above INR700 crores with EBITDA margin 26-27%; management said INR700-720 crores is achievable.
Gross margin expected to improve each quarter: about 49-51% at INR700 crores revenue, and 47% once BE and niche injectable products scale.
FY28 growth of 25-30% stated, with 25% as the minimum; INR1,000 crores revenue expected at about 29-30% EBITDA margin; INR1,500 crores targeted by FY30.
Biologics and hormone revenues excluded from guidance until FY30 per management; FY29 uplift of INR400-500 crores from BE programme was also stated.
Registrations: 6-7 new product registrations expected next quarter; Mexico alone has 70 submissions with 18-19 approved to date.
capex_capacity: Hormone plant (Unit 6) commissioning by November 2026; GMP expected around June/July 2027 after six months stability.
Oncology expansion to finish by March 2027, adding 45-50% capacity in the same facility.
Erythropoietin clinical trials to start Nov/Dec 2026 with clinical closure by Oct/Nov FY28.
Biosimilar clinical trials need about INR150 crores capex between Q3 FY28 and Q4 FY29.
Management says no additional debt needed; an extended loan exists but is unused, with a possible INR15-20 crore draw if cash flow is disrupted.
demand_pricing: Management attributes growth to first-generic and second-generic filings with ready dossiers and BE data; target portfolio of 200-250 products across 70-80 countries.
Mexico: 70 submissions, 18-19 registrations so far; Colombia 25-30 submissions; Saudi Arabia 12-13 submissions with revenue expected from end Q3 FY27.
MENA and GCC expected to be the highest-contributing region in Q4 FY27, followed by LATAM.
Raw material: 80-85% of procurement from domestic API suppliers and about 15% from China; no major disruptions so far.
Receivables from MENA, CIS and GCC improving; management cited recent large payments received.

qa_highlights.question: Why did oncology mix fall to 20% from 26%, and is the 30% target still valid?
qa_highlights.answer: Management guided oncology at 25-30% of sales, with registrations delayed to Q4 FY27; generic registrations in MENA and LATAM are driving near-term growth.

qa_highlights.question: Auditor change status?
qa_highlights.answer: KPMG agreement filed; appointment planned for Q3 or Q4 FY27 via EGM, pending software and data-system upgrades. A later answer confirmed an EGM would be needed.

qa_highlights.question: Gross margin trajectory and raw material costs?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross margin was 53% in Q1 vs 56-57% prior quarter; 35-40% of revenue still from ROW markets, which lowers margin. Target 47% long term.

qa_highlights.question: Hormone plant revenue and timing?
qa_highlights.answer: INR70-80 crores in FY28 from ROW and tender sales; around INR200 crores by FY29 if COPP and BE are completed. FY29 hormone revenue is uncertain and may slip to FY30.

qa_highlights.question: Receivables and capex funding?
qa_highlights.answer: Debtor days guided to 165-170 (from 208); capex of INR185-190 crores to be funded from internal accruals; no additional debt planned.

qa_highlights.question: Promoter stake increase?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it may plan something but has no current plan; cited a prior open-market purchase in Q3 FY26.

risks_watch: Timing of registrations (oncology in Q4 FY27; hormone BE and COPP) drives every long-range revenue number; several targets are conditional and not in current guidance.
Debtor days of 208 (improving to 165-170 target) and about 40% of revenue sitting in receivables; Middle East payment delays flagged previously.
Gross margin dropped to 53% from 56-57%; management expects improvement but the path to 47% depends on mix.
Governance: auditor change to KPMG has moved between Q3 and Q4 FY27 and conflicts with an earlier resolution extending the current auditor for five years (per shareholder question).
Related-party exposure: Mana Pharma and SD Biopharmaceuticals links via Deepak Bansal; Kaler Biopharma and an associated land deal described as on hold, with no clear resolution.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on long-range targets, with specific numbers given for FY28-FY30. Hedged where timelines depend on regulators (CDSCO, COPP, BE). Evasive on the auditor change, which shifted between Q3 and Q4 FY27 within the call, and on related-party entities.
